item.title: [LU-10484] sanity-lfsck test_18c: Expect 3 fixed on mds1, but got: 4
item.description:
sanity-lfsck test_18c - (4) Expect 3 fixed on mds1, but got: 4
^^^^^^^^^^^^^ DO NOT REMOVE LINE ABOVE ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This issue was created by maloo for Bob Glossman <bob.glossman@intel.com>

This issue relates to the following test suite run:

test_18c failed with the following error:

(4) Expect 3 fixed on mds1, but got: 4

Suspect this failure is due to some very recent landing in master.
Only 2 instances seen in a maloo search, both in the last day or so.
Both instances seen in zfs testing only.

https://testing.hpdd.intel.com/test_sets/4807d788-f5f8-11e7-94c7-52540065bddc
